Symbol:

Type:
ara::core::Optional< std::uint8_t >
Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> evt;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined event 4 bit header
field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype AAF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00...0x0F : valid
0x10...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set value of evt to 0, if it is not provided by the application.
Visibility:
protected
